semantics: perceptual (lossy) profile, the LAST mandated phase (master brief §64 Phase-U block; §72 language). Architecture: lossiness lives entirely in a deterministic integer quantization Q applied at encode time over raster-origin input. The stream encodes the chosen reconstruction F-hat = Q(F) and is decoded EXACTLY by the unchanged normative materializer (the materializer stays authoritative; the loss is declared, never hidden). src/lossy.rs: QuantProfile (lattice 2^shift, shift 0..=7; Rounding::HalfUp with saturation at the Gray8 maximum 255 for the top half-bin, or Rounding::DeadZone; optional integer [1 2 1]>>2 Box3 horizontal pre-filter with edge replication - no floating point anywhere in the normative path), quantize_frames (F-hat), Distortion (integer MAE x1000 / MSE / peak), encode_lossy (quantize -> exhaustive inverse encoder on F-hat -> mark with feature bit 0x2 FEAT_QUANTIZED_CONTENT unless exact -> PROVE the normative decoder reproduces F-hat byte-for-byte or return a typed error), rate_distortion (deterministic bytes+distortion ladder over shifts 0..=max_shift), choose_rd (budget choice = least-distorted evaluated row whose stream fits the budget; honest budget_met=false when even exact is over budget; no budget = smallest stream, tie least distorted). The bit is a pure declaration (never changes reconstruction; exact streams never set it); it survives transport (Packet::Header carries feature_bits), archive (.volea manifest build/verify of a quantized stream), and `vole optimize` (rewrites re-apply the declaration). New CLI: `vole quant`. Exact profiles are untouched: existing streams (feature_bits 0) and the whole A-T surface decode unchanged.

notes: The .vole grammar is unchanged: feature bit 0x2 (FEAT_QUANTIZED_CONTENT) is a declaration only - the header read accepts it as a known bit, reconstruction is identical with or without it, exact (lossless) streams never set it, and existing golden streams (feature_bits 0) decode unchanged.

Lossiness lives in the deterministic integer quantization Q applied by the encoder over raster-origin input; the decoder stays exact and authoritative. The chosen reconstruction F-hat = Q(F) is what the decoder reproduces; residual dropping is realized through the lattice (detail below the step never reaches a residual because the target is already on the lattice).

Quantization saturates the top half-bin at the Gray8 maximum 255 (the single non-lattice output); dead-zone rounding never leaves the lattice. Both behaviors are exact, documented, and courted over the full sample domain.

Bytes are not monotone in the lattice step (measured on both flagships): intermediate lattices can exceed the exact stream. choose_rd therefore selects the least-distorted evaluated row within the budget and reports an honest unmet budget when even the exact profile cannot fit - never a silent violation.

Quantizing perfectly-procedural (authored) content adds distortion without removing procedural-state bytes (recorded negative control) - the phase keeps exact profiles intact and lets the RD choice fall back to exact when it fits the budget.
No compression or quality claim beyond the measured courts: this is a declared, deterministic integer trade of bytes for measured distortion on raster-origin content, expressed in §72 language.
